name: @justybase/spreadsheet-tasks
description: High-performance TypeScript library for reading and writing Excel files in XLSB and XLSX formats. XLSB is 3.3x faster to write and 2.1x faster to read than XLSX.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && npx ts-node tests/smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: npx ts-node tests/unit/bigbuffer.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/biff-reader-writer.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/xlsb-writer.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npx ts-node tests/integration/xlsb-writer.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/integration/xlsx-writer.test.ts
scripts.test:xlsb: npm run build && npx ts-node tests/integration/xlsb-writer.test.ts
scripts.test:xlsx: npm run build && npx ts-node tests/integration/xlsx-writer.test.ts
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && npx ts-node benchmarks/performance.bench.ts
scripts.benchmark:comparison: npm run build && npx ts-node benchmarks/comparison.bench.ts
scripts.test:excel-compat: npm run build && npx tsx tests/excel-compat/run.ts

author: Krzysztof Dusko
